page.layout: One page of verse, one column, centred-indented lines; running head at top; page number at top left. Faint show-through of the facing page's text in the right margin is not transcribed.

main_text.p:
Non urbs acerbis unica cernitur
Intacta damnis, oppida turpibus
Quassata bellis, civibusque
Cuncta suis viduata lugent.

Non villa luctu mæsta caret domus.
Plorat mariti funera tristior
Coniux, & amisso tenellis
Patre timet mala plura natis.

Maternus, eheu! quæ dolor excitat
Lamenta, telis pectora quum videt
Traiecta natorum, patérve
Quum senior sepelit cruentos!

Quæ cuncta Gallis vulnera Gallicus
Fecisse miles gestit acerbius,
Francósque victos Francus audet
Egregius spoliare victor!

Antiqua priscis temporibus fides,
Virtúsque Francis subdita Regibus,
Hostes remotos impetiit
Arma ferens metuenda cunctis:

Et signa iustis splendida Laureis
Late per orbem Gallica protulit,
Duxítque laudatos renidens
Barbaricis opibus triumphos.

Sed nunc benignus te Superum fauor,
Rex magne, nostris fletibus annuit,
Plebes ut oppressas benignus
Tabifico releues labore

page.notes: The catchword-like word "Ultor" stands at the right below the last line; it is printed as a line of text, not a catchword. Faint show-through from the reverse side and a faint mark near the top left of the text are not transcribed.
